compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 1206 680 pF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C1878 (FH 1206B681K500NT, X7R +/-10% 50 V, intake completed earlier this session). C1923 is the exact FH C0G +/-5% SKU (1206CG681J500NT, 50 V) from the same maker, so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. An earlier attempt in this same intake classified C1923 as a new generic by mistake; the scaffold refusal caught it and the edits were corrected to the variant form before any record was created. Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 680 pF value, package and 50 V rating, but C0G +/-5% is the more stable, tighter-tolerance dielectric than the X7R +/-10% preference; projects needing C0G stability at 680 pF/1206 should pick this variant explicitly and the X7R preference is not downgraded. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 1 at capture recorded as observed (extremely low; does not change identity). Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
